name: Recursive Semantic Reference Registry
purpose: Formalize bounded recursive self-reference behavior without permitting closure absolutism or semantic self-completion.

reference_classes.definition: Recursive reference that successfully traces part of its own interpretive history.
Reference behavior constrained by mandatory participatory feedback limits.
Recursive structures that achieve transient stability by oscillating between opposing aspect roles.
Self-reference that leads to semantic decay or the accumulation of interpretive noise.
Recursive pathways where self-completion is formally prohibited by framework constraints.

mandatory_constraints.statement: Recursive reference does not imply semantic closure.
Self-description remains bounded by embedded observer limits.
Recursive stabilization does not imply truth or source recovery.

governance_rules.rule: Every recursive semantic artifact must identify its primary feedback mode and depth limit.
Claims of 'absolute semantic closure' trigger immediate REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Recursive semantics proves that the framework is 'complete'.
Self-reference derives the physical origin of information.
Recursive stability justifies the assumption of an unconditioned source.
